ShortDescription.Value: Makes the in-game weather look like the current real weather of any city you choose. Purely cosmetic.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Real Weather Sync
The world is burning. Let your cims burn with you.
## Setup
1. Enable the mod. 2. Type a city - `Lyon`, or `Lyon, France` if the name is ambiguous. 3. Press **Apply City**.
That is the whole workflow. No coordinates, no config files, no weather codes, no manual sliders.
## What it does
- **Temperature, clouds, rain and fog** taken from the real city, refreshed every 15, 30 or 60 minutes - your call. - **No setup friction.** Powered by [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/): no account, no sign-up, no API key. - **Smooth two-minute fades** between readings, on real time. Pausing or fast-forwarding the simulation does not disturb them. - **Offline-proof.** Lost your connection? It holds the last good reading instead of dumping you into a cloudless void. - **A live status panel** showing what was measured and what was applied.
## What it does NOT do
**Strictly cosmetic.** It does not touch the simulation, citizens, traffic, economy or services. It does not move the clock, the date, the season or the day/night cycle. It does not summon thunderstorms, auroras or disasters. And it writes **nothing** into your savegame.
The only things it changes are the same four visual climate values the game's own developer tools expose.
## Known limitation: rain vs snow
The game decides rain-or-snow from the visual temperature - there is no "draw snow" switch for mods. So when it is genuinely snowing somewhere mild, **Show snow when it is really snowing** (on by default) nudges the visual temperature just below freezing so you actually get snowflakes. The displayed temperature is then a bit off. Turn it off if you would rather have an honest thermometer than honest snow. Either way the season and date stay untouched.
## Compatibility
**Do not run this alongside another weather-overriding mod** - Time and Weather Anarchy, Weather Plus, Nice Weather, day/night switchers. Two mods fighting over the same climate values ends badly.
Real Weather Sync watches for the known ones and stands down if it spots one, reporting *"Incompatible weather mod active"*. That check matches on mod names, so it is a guard rail, not a guarantee.
No dependencies. No Harmony. Public game APIs only.
## Privacy
Two things leave your PC: **the city name you type** (to Open-Meteo's geocoder) and **the coordinates it returns** (to Open-Meteo's forecast endpoint). That is it. No telemetry, no analytics, no identifiers.
## Licence and attribution
MIT. Weather and geocoding data by [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/), licensed [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Publish.ChangeLog:
# 1.0.0
First public release.
- Resolve any real city by name (`City` or `City, Country`) through Open-Meteo geocoding. - Fetch current conditions every 15, 30 or 60 minutes. - Override temperature, cloudiness, precipitation and fog - visual only. - Documented, clamped mapping: piecewise rain and snow intensity curves, a WMO weather-code intensity floor, and a conservative fog curve based on fog codes and visibility. - Smooth 120 second transitions driven by real time, unaffected by pause or simulation speed. - Retains the last good reading, so a failed refresh never produces zeroed or extreme weather. - Retry backoff and single-flight requests; the API is never hammered. - Detects known weather-overriding mods and stands down when one is active. - Live status panel and full en-US localisation.
